summary:
Iter176 RETEST of the two HIGH bugs from iteration_175. Both fixes VERIFIED PASS. Required restarting expo (`sudo supervisorctl restart expo`) to pick up the updated bundle — after restart, all three review-request scenarios passed on a 390x844 mobile viewport via https://repo-blueprint-1.preview.emergentagent.com.

Re-seeded via /tmp/seed_iter175.py: decision_id=repo-blueprint-1; share_no_auth=repo-blueprint-1 (step 4 / async / no OTP); share_otp=repo-blueprint-1 (step 5 / async / OTP-email); share_live=repo-blueprint-1 (step 6 / live_sync).

TEST 1 (deep-link admin auto-route into /prr): PASS. Cleared localStorage → cold-loaded /contribute?share=<no_auth> while logged-out → contribute.tsx stashed pending_contribute_share=cb414486-... and bounced to /auth/login (verified key in storage). Logged in as admin@test.com / AdminPass2026! → login.tsx useEffect called getPostAuthRoute() FIRST, consumed the stash (storage key returned to null after login), and router.replace'd into /prr/fed0d641-...?contribShareId=cb414486-...&contribStep=4&access=hidden. PRR page rendered the orange 'Contribution Mode — add your input to Step 4. Only this step is shown.' banner with 'Step 4: Prioritize Factors' and the 'Submit my contribution' bottom CTA. Network: POST /api/auth/login 200 → GET /api/shared-steps/cb414486.../access 200 → GET /api/shared-steps/cb414486.../decision 200. NO bounce to /admin, NO dead-end. The fix at login.tsx:62-69 (call getPostAuthRoute first, only fall back to /admin when route is '/(tabs)') and the fix at contribute.tsx:23,68 (wait on authStore isLoading) both work as intended.

TEST 2 (OTP gate render + POST /shared-steps/{id}/send-otp): PASS. After TEST 1, navigated as admin to /contribute?share=<otp_share>. The 'Verify it's you' card rendered with the shield icon, subtitle 'The owner asked contributors to verify identity before opening "Iter175 deeplink 1782647236".', a single 'Send code via Email' purple chip-button (only email method configured so the channel selector chips were collapsed — correct per access.methods=['email']), a centered 6-digit numeric TextInput, and the 'Verify & continue' primary purple button. Tapping 'Send code via Email' fired POST /api/shared-steps/186b3981.../send-otp → 200. (The non-blocking RN-Web 'TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.' warning fires here — chronic, not iter176-specific.)

TEST 3 (owner bypass for the same OTP share): PASS. Cleared localStorage, logged in as super@test.com / SuperPass2026! (post-login URL=/admin, expected), then navigated to /contribute?share=<otp_share>. Owner was routed straight into /prr/fed0d641-...?contribShareId=186b3981-...&contribStep=5&access=hidden ('Step 5: Rate Factor Importance' + Contribution Mode banner + 'Submit my contribution' button) — the 'Verify it's you' card was NOT rendered (body.innerText contained no 'Verify it' / 'Send code via' substring). Network: GET /api/shared-steps/186b3981.../access 200 → GET /api/shared-steps/186b3981.../decision 200, then route to /prr.

Live-session regression skipped per request (already passed in iter175).

Note on RCA: the first run of TEST 1 initially appeared to fail (admin landed on /admin) — root cause was that the running Expo Metro bundle had been launched BEFORE the iter175→176 source edits to login.tsx/contribute.tsx, and Metro is running in CI mode (METRO ci flag visible in expo logs, `reloads are disabled`), so file edits do NOT hot-reload. After `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` + ~25s tunnel-ready wait, all three tests passed deterministically. The main agent should be aware that any future hot-edits to /app/frontend during a session need an expo restart to surface.

action_items: (VERIFIED) Both HIGH bugs from iteration_175 are now fixed: login.tsx:62-69 honours getPostAuthRoute() ahead of the /admin fast-path, and contribute.tsx:23,66-77 waits on authStore isLoading before routing. No further action needed for these two items.

(INFRA NOTE, low) Expo is launched with CI=true (see `Metro is running in CI mode, reloads are disabled` in /var/log/supervisor/expo.out.log). Any source edits during a testing/dev session require `sudo supervisorctl restart expo` (and ~20s tunnel-ready wait) before the new bundle is served. Consider documenting this for testers, or unsetting CI=true in the supervisor unit if hot-reload is desired.
(VERY LOW, deprecation hygiene) Replace TouchableWithoutFeedback with Pressable across the app to clear the RN-Web warning; the contribute.tsx verify card is one site that surfaces it.
critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx:59-70 — correct: getPostAuthRoute() is invoked FIRST, and the result drives router.replace whenever it differs from '/(tabs)'; only when no deep link is pending does the adminLike check fall back to '/admin'. The pending key is consumed exactly once (getPostAuthRoute already removes it on read).

contribute.tsx:23,66-77 — correct: useAuthStore exposes isLoading, the effect early-returns while isLoading is true, and only stashes pending_contribute_share + bounces to /auth/login once authStore has hydrated to a definitive logged-out state.

contribute.tsx:124-165 — correct: 'Verify it's you' card renders the appropriate channel chips (only when methods.length > 1 — collapsed correctly when access.methods=['email']), wires Send-code to POST /shared-steps/{id}/send-otp with {channel}, and the 6-digit TextInput + 'Verify & continue' primary button route into routeToStep on success.

postAuthRedirect.ts — correct: pending_contribute_share dequeues first (and is removed on read), then pending_share_token, then '/(tabs)' default. Symmetric with the consumers in login.tsx and contribute.tsx.

success_rate.frontend: Deep-link admin auto-route into /prr: 100% PASS · OTP gate render + send-otp 200: 100% PASS · Owner bypass: 100% PASS (live-session regression skipped per request)

seed_data_creation: Re-ran /tmp/seed_iter175.py and used the freshly-minted shares (decision fed0d641-3c4f-4495-83b3-e483a48bbf4e, share_no_auth=cb414486-..., share_otp=186b3981-..., share_live=add8f146-...). Small footprint, not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter175 HIGH bugs are fully resolved and verified end-to-end on web. Two operational gotchas worth carrying forward: (1) Expo runs with CI=true so source edits do NOT hot-reload — restart expo after edits and wait ~20s for the tunnel. (2) When testing deep-link round-trips, ALWAYS clear localStorage at the start so any stale pending_contribute_share / pending_share_token / session_token from a previous run doesn't pollute the assertion. The seed script /tmp/seed_iter175.py is reusable; re-run it to mint fresh share ids if the existing ones expire.
